title: Just Artoria
teaser: Away from white coats and operating rooms on a quiet day off, Ryuji Sakaguchi sees Artoria's love of good food, accepts her invitation home for the night, and shares a smoky morning kitchen and an honest breakfast table with the woman behind the title.
gallery_caption: Standing in a plain linen apron with spatula in hand before burnt bacon and a smoking toaster, Deputy Chief Artoria Pendragon faces a culinary crisis—before finally setting every burden down across a sunlit breakfast table.

choices.choice_ar4_c1_a: (Pick up the untouched freshly fried croquette from your plate and place it onto hers) "Since you respect the chef so deeply, care to handle my half of the courtesy too?"
choices.choice_ar4_c1_b: "Work at the hospital is always making you miss meals—it's nice to finally see the deputy chief eat a piping-hot lunch on time."
choices.choice_ar4_c1_c: "Looks like I'd better save this place in my notes—next time late shifts keep us past dinner, I'll know what can coax you away from your desk."
choices.choice_ar4_c2_a: "What a coincidence—I was just thinking the day went by too fast myself. For the rest of tonight, my time is yours alone."
choices.choice_ar4_c2_b: "Since the deputy chief is officially off duty today, stop mapping out routes for everyone else—let's go wherever you want to go."
choices.choice_ar4_c2_c: (Step half a pace closer naturally) "Honestly, from the moment I saw you in casual clothes under the clock tower this morning, I wasn't planning on heading home this early."
choices.choice_ar4_c3_a: "Truly caring for everyone doesn't mean you have a way to make everyone happy—and you're part of that team too, not someone meant to be sacrificed."
choices.choice_ar4_c3_b: "The very reason people trust your lead is that you never treat someone's disappointment like a cold number. Just stop using yourself as the buffer."
choices.choice_ar4_c3_c: "Even I'm still figuring out the best answer to that one. At least from now on, you don't have to shut the door and wrestle with it alone."

nodes.ar4_s1_01: On a rare morning off with no hospital handover briefing to attend, ginkgo leaves along both sides of the avenue rustled softly in the breeze.
nodes.ar4_s1_02: When Ryuji Sakaguchi arrived beneath the clock tower at the station's south exit ten minutes ahead of their eleven o'clock meeting time, he spotted the figure standing quietly beside the shade of the trees at first glance.
nodes.ar4_s1_03: Perhaps because he was so used to seeing her in a white coat or sterile surgical gown under the shadowless lamps, seeing Artoria Pendragon dressed in a cream-white knit sweater and deep navy skirt with a simple leather shoulder bag drew lingering glances even from passersby.
nodes.ar4_s1_04: Noticing his footsteps, Artoria turned around, her emerald-green eyes brightening slightly as she offered a polite, poised nod:
nodes.ar4_s1_05: "Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi. Here I thought I had left home plenty early today, yet you arrived ahead of time as well."
nodes.ar4_s1_06: Sakaguchi came to a stop beside her, took in her rare off-duty attire from head to toe, and smiled warmly:
nodes.ar4_s1_07: "Good morning, Dr. Artoria. That outfit really suits you today—I almost didn't dare call out right away."
nodes.ar4_s1_08: Artoria glanced down at the cuff of her trench coat, the faintest trace of shyness brushing across her fair ear even as her tone remained entirely earnest:
nodes.ar4_s1_09: "We are visiting people who have already been discharged, after all; showing up in clothes creased from hospital duty would be far too discourteous. Your casual attire looks very sharp as well, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar4_s1_10: From her small shoulder bag she drew a neatly folded square memo slip, where two addresses for midday and afternoon were written out in tidy, graceful script:
nodes.ar4_s1_11: "After Miss Fujimura came back to the hospital a few days ago to have her sutures removed, she called specifically to invite us for a casual lunch near her dojo; and when Irisviel heard that both of us were off today, she sent word hoping we might join her for tea this afternoon. Since you and I stood at the table together for both operations, I'm certain they will both be delighted that you agreed to come along."
nodes.ar4_s1_12: Looking at a schedule organized down to the minute even on a day off, Sakaguchi couldn't resist teasing her a little:
nodes.ar4_s1_13: "On a rare day off together, we've got one recently discharged patient at noon and another in the afternoon—anyone watching might think the deputy chief of surgery is taking me on outpatient follow-up rounds over the weekend."
nodes.ar4_s1_14: Artoria's fingers paused slightly on the memo slip before she looked up to correct him in earnest:
nodes.ar4_s1_15: "Today is neither ward rounds nor a follow-up exam. Their postoperative labs were already cleared at the clinic—today we are keeping these appointments as invited friends."
nodes.ar4_s1_16: Having said that, she seemed to realize herself that 'two people heading out together on their day off' carried a personal ring quite distinct from official business; her long lashes fluttered once as she tucked the slip back into her bag, her voice softening by half a beat:
nodes.ar4_s1_17: "...Besides, when we spend all our time inside the hospital, we rarely get a chance to walk side by side down the street like this. Shall we set off, Dr. Sakaguchi? Fujimura Dojo is only a twelve-minute walk from here."
nodes.ar4_s1_18: Seeing the faint upward curve at the corner of her lips, Sakaguchi answered with a smile:
nodes.ar4_s2_01: Even before they turned into the lane where the Fujimura family kendo dojo stood, the crisp, rhythmic stomp of bare feet on wooden floorboards and the spirited kiai shouts of young students practicing with bamboo shinai drifted out over the courtyard wall.
nodes.ar4_s2_02: Standing by the dojo entrance veranda with her hands on her hips and a beaming grin as she watched her pupils drill basic swings, Taiga Fujimura caught sight of the two approaching from the corner; her eyes lit up like a pair of lanterns, and she waved her arm enthusiastically:
nodes.ar4_s2_03: "Hey—! Dr. Artoria! Dr. Sakaguchi! Over here, over here!"
nodes.ar4_s2_04: As the two drew near, Taiga first called back inside—'Acting instructor, keep an eye on them; anyone slacking off gets twenty extra swings when I'm back!'—before trotting happily down the steps and patting her loose cardigan jacket to prove her innocence:
nodes.ar4_s2_05: "Just for the record, I've followed both doctors' discharge orders to the letter! Haven't touched a heavy shinai once, haven't stepped onto the floor to spar—just standing on the veranda running my mouth in the breeze every day. Listen to how loud those brats are; having them hollering nearby has me healing twice as fast as anyone else!"
nodes.ar4_s2_06: Taking in her rosy complexion and steady breathing, Artoria let genuine relief warm her eyes:
nodes.ar4_s2_07: "Your color really is even better than the day your stitches came out. Do you still feel any pulling around your upper abdominal incision when you take a deep breath?"
nodes.ar4_s2_09: "Stopped bothering me ages ago! And we agreed—no stiff hospital talk at lunch today. Come on, follow me! The owner of Takeyatei around the next corner is an old friend of mine; I asked him three days ago to save us the brightest table by the window!"
nodes.ar4_s2_10: Takeyatei was a long-standing neighborhood set-meal diner with only six or seven wooden tables; the moment they lifted the noren curtain, the toasted aroma of freshly fried croquettes straight out of the oil, the savory fat of charcoal-grilled sea fish, and the sweet steam of new-harvest kettle rice rushed out to greet them.
nodes.ar4_s2_11: Showing them to their seats like a regular, Taiga ordered a light, low-oil sea bream chazuke with dashi tamagoyaki for herself, then swept a grand hand over the menu to order the house's finest deluxe platters for both guests:
nodes.ar4_s2_12: "I'm still avoiding greasy food while I recover, so I won't fight you for them—which means my two lifesavers have to eat my share today! Boss, two deluxe sets with freshly fried Wagyu-potato croquettes, charcoal-grilled salted horse mackerel, and teriyaki chicken steak—and make the rice large bowls from the fresh pot!"
nodes.ar4_s2_13: Steaming lacquered wooden trays were soon set upon the table.
nodes.ar4_s2_14: The golden-crisp crusts of the croquettes were still faintly sizzling, savory steam rising from their cut halves; beside them lay horse mackerel with charred skin and tender flesh, paired with glossy, plump white rice and fragrant clam miso soup.
nodes.ar4_s2_15: Sitting across the table, Sakaguchi happened to glance sideways at Artoria beside him—and very nearly laughed out loud.
nodes.ar4_s2_16: The deputy chief of surgery who remained unshakable before the fiercest major-vessel hemorrhage under the operating lights had, at the exact instant her gaze landed on the golden croquettes and large bowl of fresh rice, lit up with unmistakable, radiant brilliance in her emerald-green eyes.
nodes.ar4_s2_17: Putting her palms neatly together with a proper 'Thank you for the meal,' she picked up her chopsticks and lifted half a piping-hot croquette to her mouth.
nodes.ar4_s2_18: After the faint crunch of the crisp shell, Artoria narrowed her eyes ever so slightly.
nodes.ar4_s2_19: Her posture remained impeccably upright and graceful, her chopstick manners and chewing beyond reproach—nothing remotely coarse or wolfish—yet the sheer, undivided bliss radiating from her, as though every warm bite were healing her very soul, was overwhelmingly transparent and vividly alive.
nodes.ar4_s2_20: Resting her chin in her palm across the table for three seconds, Taiga burst into a delighted giggle:
nodes.ar4_s2_21: "Whoa... watching Dr. Artoria eat works up an appetite better than any gourmet TV show! If I'd known you loved Takeyatei's croquettes this much, I would've stuffed two meal vouchers into your hand the day I was discharged!"
nodes.ar4_s2_22: Artoria froze mid-motion, swallowed her bite, and let an almost imperceptible blush tint her fair cheeks before lifting her teacup to answer with deadpan gravity:
nodes.ar4_s2_23: "...The potatoes selected by the proprietor are velvety and naturally sweet, and the frying temperature is impeccable. Savoring every dish prepared with care is simply basic courtesy toward the chef."
nodes.ar4_c1a_01: Using the serving chopsticks, Sakaguchi picked up the untouched golden croquette from his own plate and set it smoothly onto Artoria's side dish:
nodes.ar4_c1a_02: "Their portions really are generous. Since we're paying our respects to the chef, why don't I entrust my half of that courtesy to you as well?"
nodes.ar4_c1a_03: Artoria blinked her emerald eyes, her gaze lingering for a second between the extra croquette on her dish and Sakaguchi's smiling face—torn between polite refusal and a complete inability to look away—before finally giving a solemn nod:
nodes.ar4_c1a_04: "...Since food must never be wasted, I shall gratefully accept. Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.ar4_c1a_05: Across from them, Taiga's shoulders shook with laughter:
nodes.ar4_c1a_06: "Hey, hey—Dr. Sakaguchi did that way too smoothly!"
nodes.ar4_c1b_01: Sakaguchi took a sip of hot miso soup and smiled across at Taiga:
nodes.ar4_c1b_02: "You haven't seen what she's like when things get busy at the hospital—working through two or three in the afternoon over half a cup of cold black tea happens all the time. Thanks to you today, Miss Fujimura, I finally get to watch her eat a piping-hot lunch on schedule."
nodes.ar4_c1b_04: "Seriously?! Performing surgeries that tough without eating on time—that's no good at all!"
nodes.ar4_c1b_05: With the tips of her ears faintly pink, Artoria gave a quiet cough:
nodes.ar4_c1b_06: "...I have been much more mindful about eating on schedule lately."
nodes.ar4_c1c_01: Looking at her contented profile, Sakaguchi chuckled lightly:
nodes.ar4_c1c_02: "Looks like I should underline Takeyatei in my memo pad. Next time the surgical schedule runs past dinner, at least I'll know whose croquettes to mention to coax a certain workaholic deputy chief away from her desk."
nodes.ar4_c1c_03: Artoria's fingers tightened slightly around her chopsticks as she glanced up at Sakaguchi, though the corner of her mouth curved faintly despite herself:
nodes.ar4_c1c_04: "...If it is of this establishment's caliber, I admit it would be difficult to refuse."
nodes.ar4_s2m_01: Lighthearted banter aside, once lunch drew to a close and the owner brought out hot roasted green tea to settle their stomachs, Taiga cradled her cup, gazed out the sunlit window at dojo students passing by now and then, and grew a touch more serious:
nodes.ar4_s2m_02: "Honestly, the night before I was admitted, lying there in bed, I was secretly terrified—wondering what I'd do if I came out of liver surgery winded after two steps, turned into an invalid who could never set foot in the dojo again."
nodes.ar4_s2m_03: Turning her gaze back, she bowed her head squarely and respectfully toward Artoria and Sakaguchi:
nodes.ar4_s2m_04: "Now every morning when I wake up, hear the bamboo swords out in the yard, and touch my stomach knowing the half that remained is still working hard for me inside, I think how wonderful it is to be alive. Dr. Artoria, Dr. Sakaguchi—thank you for leaving my everyday life intact."
nodes.ar4_s2m_05: Artoria set down her teacup and returned the bow with warm solemnity:
nodes.ar4_s2m_06: "Seeing you standing beside your dojo in such high spirits is the finest thanks a surgeon could ask for, Miss Fujimura. Give yourself two more months of patient recovery—and when the day comes that you formally take up a shinai again, please let us know anytime."
nodes.ar4_s2m_07: As they said goodbye outside Takeyatei, Taiga stood waving by the shopfront, watching the man and woman walk side by side down the tree-lined afternoon street before calling out cheerfully after them:
nodes.ar4_s2m_08: "Walking together without your white coats today, you two look way more relaxed than at the hospital! Have a great time this afternoon too—!"
nodes.ar4_s2m_09: Artoria's steps faltered for half a beat; she did not turn back to protest, yet as they crossed the crosswalk, her shoulder—ordinarily kept at a textbook half-pace colleague's distance—drifted unconsciously a fraction closer to Sakaguchi's.
nodes.ar4_s3_01: If Taiga's dojo and neighborhood diner at noon had brimmed with lively everyday warmth, the garden teahouse nestled among maples and slender bamboo that afternoon was so tranquil that only the crisp clack of the bamboo water pipe against blue stone could be heard.
nodes.ar4_s3_02: Dressed in a deep wine-burgundy long-sleeve blouse and white skirt, Irisviel von Einzbern was seated on a cushion by the open veranda, basking in the soft afternoon sunlight. Catching sight of the attendant guiding the two along the wooden corridor, she rose at once with a welcoming smile:
nodes.ar4_s3_03: "Welcome, Artoria, and Dr. Sakaguchi. It isn't a short trip—thank you both for coming all this way on your day off."
nodes.ar4_s3_04: Stepping forward, Artoria let her gaze rest naturally and attentively on her old friend's cheeks—ever so slightly fuller than half a month ago—and her expression softened:
nodes.ar4_s3_05: "Please sit down, Irisviel. Since switching to five or six small soft meals a day, have you had any acid reflux or post-meal palpitations and sweating from dumping syndrome?"
nodes.ar4_s3_06: Irisviel covered her lips with a light chuckle:
nodes.ar4_s3_07: "Your very first sentence upon meeting really is a doctor's consultation. Rest assured, I've been following the dietary plan you and Dr. Sakaguchi wrote to the letter—stopping at sixty percent full and taking a gentle stroll in the garden afterward, without the slightest discomfort. Even the tea here was switched at my request to a mild, low-caffeine hojicha, with just two small pieces of steamed yam cake to host you."
nodes.ar4_s3_08: Taking a seat beside Artoria, Sakaguchi chimed in with a warm smile:
nodes.ar4_s3_09: "You're stabilizing even more smoothly than expected. At this rate, you won't even have to wait until the end of the year before easing back toward three regular meals."
nodes.ar4_s3_10: Irisviel personally poured clear, gentle tea for them both, cradled her own plain porcelain cup in both hands, and turned her clear ruby-red eyes warmly toward Sakaguchi:
nodes.ar4_s3_11: "That day in the operating room, thanks to your steady anesthesia and teamwork, Dr. Sakaguchi, I woke up safe and sound without a single frightening memory left behind. Inviting the two of you today was also my chance to thank you again in person."
nodes.ar4_s3_13: "It was simply our duty, Madam Irisviel—and your own cooperation made all the difference."
nodes.ar4_s3_14: Midway through tea, Sakaguchi excused himself to rinse his hands at the stone basin outside the veranda, pausing a moment to admire the white camellias blooming in a corner of the garden.
nodes.ar4_s3_15: As he dried his hands and walked slowly back toward the bend in the wooden corridor, the quiet, gentle voices of the two old friends drifted out from the open pavilion.
nodes.ar4_s3_16: Watching Artoria sit poised across from her while her gaze quietly followed a falling leaf in the courtyard, Irisviel suddenly curved her eyes in a soft smile and spoke:
nodes.ar4_s3_19: "Why do you say that all of a sudden?"
nodes.ar4_s3_20: "Because in all the years I've known you, even when we sat having tea on a work-free afternoon, your back was always held so taut—as if you were ready at any moment to step out and shield everyone around you from the rain."
nodes.ar4_s3_21: The silver-haired woman's gaze drifted past the pavilion pillar toward the tall figure walking back along the corridor, then settled fondly once more on her dear friend's noticeably softened profile:
nodes.ar4_s3_22: "Yet between the moment you walked in today and now, you've smiled several times without even noticing. It seems that at this hospital, you finally have someone beside you who lets you stop carrying everything alone—someone you can walk alongside with an easy heart."
nodes.ar4_s3_23: Artoria's fingertips trembled ever so slightly against her teacup.
nodes.ar4_s3_24: Following Irisviel's gaze over her shoulder, she met Ryuji Sakaguchi's eyes just as he stepped back onto the veranda stairs.
nodes.ar4_s3_25: This time, she did not rush to deny it the way she usually did when teased by subordinates; instead, a delicate warmth rose across her fair cheeks as she lowered her lashes over a sip of warm tea and answered quietly:
nodes.ar4_s3_26: "...Yes. He truly is someone deeply dependable."
nodes.ar4_s4_01: Mindful that a recovering patient shouldn't tire herself sitting too long, the two politely excused themselves after less than an hour at the garden teahouse.
nodes.ar4_s4_02: By the time their train brought them back from the suburbs to the city station, the sun was sinking slowly toward the distant mountain ridge, dyeing the entire surface of the Hoshimi River a tranquil amber-gold.
nodes.ar4_s4_03: There were no afternoon ward rounds to rush back for, no sudden pager beeps, and both entries written on her 'today's itinerary' slip had reached their neat conclusion.
nodes.ar4_s4_04: Walking unhurriedly along the quiet riverside promenade, they reached the fork leading toward the east and west train transfer lines, where Artoria instinctively slowed to a stop, checked her wristwatch, and turned toward Sakaguchi with the same considerate habit she showed every colleague at the hospital:
nodes.ar4_s4_05: "Thank you for accompanying me through most of the day, Dr. Sakaguchi. Turning right at the intersection ahead leads straight to the station toward your apartment—if you head over now, you'll be just in time for the 5:30 express before it gets crowded..."
nodes.ar4_s4_06: Standing in the sunset breeze, Sakaguchi looked quietly at this woman who was still calculating the optimal commute home for someone else at dusk on her day off—and did not take a step to the right.
nodes.ar4_s4_09: Artoria paused mid-sentence and looked at him:
nodes.ar4_s4_11: "From eleven this morning until now, you spent lunch keeping Miss Fujimura company, spent the afternoon looking after Madam Irisviel's recovery, and even here at the crossroads you're checking which train is less crowded for me."
nodes.ar4_s4_12: Meeting those clear emerald-green eyes, he slowed his voice and asked the question gently and directly:
nodes.ar4_s4_13: "If there were no itinerary left to arrange right now, and no one else's schedule you needed to look after—what would you yourself want to do most at this moment?"
nodes.ar4_s4_14: The evening breeze off the riverbank brushed through the ginkgo branches, lifting a few pale-gold strands beside Artoria's ear.
nodes.ar4_s4_15: She stood motionless where she was, as though she had never imagined the question would suddenly be turned back toward herself.
nodes.ar4_s4_16: Not coordinating the whole department as deputy chief of surgery, not reassuring a patient as primary surgeon, not even reaching for some 'conveniently on the way' work excuse—once every outward duty was gently peeled back, the wish left behind in this twilight was so simple it almost startled her.
nodes.ar4_s4_17: After four or five full seconds of silence, Artoria lowered her lashes and raised them again to look straight into Sakaguchi's eyes, a unmistakable blush rising across her fair cheeks in the sunset glow, her voice quiet yet utterly honest:
nodes.ar4_s4_18: "...If you are asking only what I myself wish to do."
nodes.ar4_s4_19: "I do not want to say goodbye to you at this crossroads yet. ...I don't want today to end so soon."
nodes.ar4_c2a_01: Looking into her flushed yet unwavering eyes, Sakaguchi broke into a warm smile:
nodes.ar4_c2a_02: "What a coincidence—I was just thinking today went by far too fast myself. Since we feel the same way, my time for the rest of the evening belongs to you alone."
nodes.ar4_c2a_03: The taut corners of Artoria's lips relaxed softly, a remarkably tender smile rippling in the depths of her eyes:
nodes.ar4_c2a_04: "...Hearing that you feel the same puts my heart at ease."
nodes.ar4_c2b_01: Sakaguchi shook his head, his voice gentle and certain:
nodes.ar4_c2b_02: "Let the 5:30 express leave on its own. Since Deputy Chief Pendragon is thoroughly off the clock today, let's spend the rest of the evening going only where you want to go."
nodes.ar4_c2b_03: Artoria blinked in brief surprise, then drew a quiet breath, her eyes bright and warm:
nodes.ar4_c2b_04: "...All right. Just this once, I won't map out anyone else's route."
nodes.ar4_c2c_01: Sakaguchi stepped half a pace closer, looking down at her in the cool riverside breeze:
nodes.ar4_c2c_02: "Truth be told, from 10:50 this morning when I saw you standing under the clock tower in these clothes, I had zero intention of dutifully boarding a train home at five-thirty."
nodes.ar4_c2c_03: Heat rushed to the base of Artoria's ears in a rare flash of flustered shyness, yet she did not retreat even half an inch:
nodes.ar4_c2c_04: "...So you were thinking that all the way back this morning."
nodes.ar4_s4m_01: Dusk crept inch by inch up the riverbank as streetlamps along the walkway flickered on one after another in a soft, warm amber glow.
nodes.ar4_s4m_02: Standing beneath the lamplight, Artoria looked at the man before her. She understood with complete clarity why her pulse was quickening now, and exactly what the invitation she was about to voice meant—without a shred of naive misunderstanding, and without needing 'discussing a case' as cover.
nodes.ar4_s4m_03: Drawing a deep breath, she lifted her gaze and offered the invitation of her own accord in a voice as poised as ever, yet far gentler than usual:
nodes.ar4_s4m_04: "My apartment is in a quiet neighborhood just across the next two bridges—less than a ten-minute walk from here."
nodes.ar4_s4m_05: Her fingers curled lightly around the strap of her shoulder bag, her emerald-green eyes reflecting Sakaguchi's figure with open candor:
nodes.ar4_s4m_06: "I haven't prepared anything special to host you... but if you're willing, tonight... would you like to come over to my place for a while?"
nodes.ar4_s4m_07: Seeing the blend of shyness and unflinching sincerity in her eyes, Sakaguchi reached out and naturally took her cool fingertips gently in his hand:
nodes.ar4_s4m_09: Artoria's fingertips trembled faintly against his palm before quietly, firmly closing around his hand in return.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_01: With a soft click, the entryway lock closed behind them, shutting the cool night breeze outside the window for good.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_02: The warm yellow living-room floor lamp came on. Inviting Sakaguchi to sit on the tidy fabric sofa, Artoria stepped into the kitchen to boil water, deftly warmed the pot and steeped the leaves, and emerged minutes later with two fragrant cups of Darjeeling black tea—nothing like someone lacking domestic competence, every detail reflecting her signature orderliness and care.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_03: Accepting the warm porcelain cup, Sakaguchi glanced around at the leafy plant beside the bookshelf and the two casual meal receipts clipped under magnets on the refrigerator, smiling warmly:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_04: "Just as clean and comfortable as the impression you give. Though I half expected your bookshelf to be one hundred percent surgical monographs."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_05: Artoria sat down half a cushion's width beside him; undone from its daytime braid, her pale-gold hair spilled smoothly down over her shoulders, trading a measure of her hospital command for a gentle feminine softness:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_06: "If even the place I came home to after work looked like the surgical reference room, life would be far too dry. Still, on nights when back-to-back operations run too late, I end up ordering bento from a nearby shop to get by."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_07: Cradling their teacups, the two chatted quietly about the day. No urgent ticking clock pressed upon the living room—only the curling ribbons of steam above their black tea.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_08: After finishing half her cup, Artoria set the white porcelain teacup gently back onto the coffee table.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_09: Turning slightly toward Sakaguchi right beside her, she fell silent for two seconds before speaking softly:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_10: "...Since stepping through the door, you have called me 'Dr. Artoria' three times."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_13: The tips of Artoria's ears turned faintly pink, yet her gaze remained clear and warm upon him:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_14: "This isn't the fourth-floor operating suite or the third-floor surgical office. The person sitting here tonight isn't any deputy chief of surgery... just Artoria."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_15: Pausing half a beat, she tried out a new form of address in a quiet, gentle voice:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_16: "So while we are here... may I drop 'Doctor' as well, and simply call you 'Sakaguchi-kun'?"
nodes.ar4_s5_1_17: Looking at the woman under the warm lamp with golden hair loose over her shoulders and eyes so clear they stirred his chest, Sakaguchi set down his teacup and spoke her name in a low voice:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_19: Hearing her own name spoken by him stripped of every title made Artoria's long eyelashes quiver ever so slightly.
nodes.ar4_s5_1_20: Without searching for any roundabout change of subject, she closed the last half-arm's distance between them on her own initiative and raised her hand, her warm fingertips resting lightly against the front of his shirt:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_21: "Sakaguchi-kun... I didn't ask you to stay tonight because you accompanied me to see friends today, nor out of obligation for your help at work."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_22: A blush spread all the way down to the base of her neck and her breathing grew slightly quicker than usual, yet she met his gaze openly and proudly:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_23: "It is simply because I love spending time with you... Tonight, I want to be closer to you, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar4_s5_1_24: Sakaguchi raised an arm around her slender yet supple waist, his fingertips brushing gently through her loose pale-gold hair as he leaned down toward her lips:
nodes.ar4_s5_1_26: Warm breaths mingled into one as the glow of the living-room lamp swayed quietly beside the two figures drawn together in a kiss.
nodes.ar4_s5_2_01: As night deepened, a quiet sliver of moonlight filtered through the gap in the bedroom curtains.
nodes.ar4_s5_2_02: Heated, breathless gasps gradually subsided. With tousled pale-gold hair spilled across the pillow, Artoria Pendragon lay on her side against the warmth of Ryuji Sakaguchi's chest, the sheet resting low across their touching shoulders.
nodes.ar4_s5_2_03: Those shoulders—ordinarily held straight enough to bear the weight of an entire surgical department at any moment—had let go of every ounce of tension, rising and falling gently with her even, unhurried breathing.
nodes.ar4_s5_2_04: Cradling her shoulder, Sakaguchi brushed a damp golden strand softly back from her cheek:
nodes.ar4_s5_2_06: Artoria opened her emerald eyes slightly, still dewy with pleasant drowsiness, nestled half an inch closer into his arms, and answered in a voice as soft as a sigh:
nodes.ar4_s5_2_07: "...Yes. It just feels a little unreal, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar4_s5_2_09: "I always used to think that so long as I stayed clear-headed and strong enough, spending my hours off by myself was perfectly fine... I never realized how quiet my heart could feel, thinking of nothing at all and simply being held in your arms like this, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar4_s5_2_10: Beneath the sheet her fingers laced lightly with Sakaguchi's palm as her eyelids drifted slowly shut with warm sleepiness:
nodes.ar4_s5_2_11: "No early-shift alarm tonight... Good night, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar4_s5_2_12: Sakaguchi pressed a light kiss to her forehead:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_01: Early the next morning, soft daylight filtered through the sheer curtains into the bedroom.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_02: When Sakaguchi woke up, the pillow beside him was already empty, a faint trace of warmth lingering under the covers.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_03: Just as he slipped on his shirt and fastened his cuffs to step out of the room, his nose twitched slightly—mixed in with the crisp fragrance of black tea in the air was an increasingly unmistakable hint of... something scorching?
nodes.ar4_s6_1_04: An instant later, from the open kitchen beyond the living room came the urgent scrape of a metal spatula against a pan bottom, followed by one sharp, piercing electronic warning chirp:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_06: With a jolt, Sakaguchi pushed open the bedroom door in quick strides.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_07: Before the sunlit kitchen stove stood Artoria Pendragon—already washed up and neatly wearing a plain off-white cotton-linen apron tied squarely over her loungewear—holding a spatula in one hand as her other swiftly turned off the gas burner knob and cleanly pulled the toaster plug beside it.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_08: The round smoke detector on the ceiling blinked red twice; thankfully, because the heat had been cut in time, that single warning chirp died away without setting off the building's fire alarm.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_09: The scene on the stovetop itself, however, was decidedly grim—
nodes.ar4_s6_1_10: Propped open on the recipe stand to the left was a brand-new copy of 'Ten-Minute Energizing Western Breakfasts for Beginners,' while in the skillet on the right, the whites of two fried eggs had scorched fast to the pan and three strips of bacon beside them had carbonized into stiff, pitch-black bars; from the freshly unplugged toaster slot, a thin wisp of blue smoke was still drifting lazily upward.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_11: There was no panicked shrieking, no clumsy knocking things over. The deputy chief of surgery who only yesterday could navigate millimeter-thin tissue planes with effortless mastery was now standing spatula in hand before a pan of 'charcoal bacon,' her expression as grave as if confronting an unsolved mystery of modern medicine.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_12: Hearing footsteps behind her, Artoria stiffened slightly and turned her head around slowly, her fair cheeks blushing crimson all the way to the tips of her ears:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_13: "...Good morning, Sakaguchi-kun. Did I wake you? Both the flame and power supply have been shut off; the area is completely secure."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_14: Walking over, Sakaguchi first slid open the kitchen side window and switched on the exhaust fan to clear the wisp of smoke, glanced down at the heroically fallen bacon in the pan, then looked at Artoria's earnestly mortified face—and genuinely couldn't hold back a laugh:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_15: "Good morning, Artoria. Top marks on rapid safety confirmation—though judging by the operative field here, I'm afraid we'll need an emergency change of primary surgeon for this morning's breakfast."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_16: Artoria's fingers tightened slightly around the spatula handle as she glanced down at the cookbook reading 'pan-fry over medium heat until lightly crisp,' wearing a rare look of sheepish defeat:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_17: "...The recipe wrote only 'fry over medium heat until the edges curl slightly,' without specifying which dial mark constitutes standard medium heat, let alone warning that the eggs would fuse to the pan before flipping... Even though I was the one who invited you to stay over, Sakaguchi-kun, and wanted at least to cook a proper breakfast for you with my own hands, I turned it into this and ended up troubling my guest instead..."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_18: Watching her solemnly indict herself for 'dereliction of duty as host' over a burnt breakfast, Sakaguchi reached out gently to take the spatula from her hand and gave the top of her head an affectionate pat:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_19: "Go sit and rest by the dining table, or just watch from beside me. There are still eggs and bacon left in the fridge, right?"
nodes.ar4_s6_1_21: "Yes, I bought a whole fresh pack at the downstairs supermarket yesterday evening on the way back."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_22: Deftly setting the scorched pan to soak in the sink and swapping in a clean small skillet, Sakaguchi glanced back at her, his tone easy yet earnest:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_23: "And put away that whole 'negligent host' speech from a moment ago. I'm making breakfast for you because I want to see you eat as happily as you did at lunch yesterday—not because you owe me anything, and certainly not so you'll pay it back with something else."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_24: Artoria stood still where she was, watching the man at the stove with his shirt cuffs rolled up.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_25: Butter melted across the warm pan in a gentle creamy fragrance, two eggs cracked in with a soft, pleasant sizzle; Sakaguchi smoothly lowered the flame to coddle glossy soft-runny yolks, used the pan's residual heat to crisp fresh bacon until ruddy and curled, and plated golden-toasted buttered bread together onto warm white porcelain.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_26: In barely ten minutes, two inviting, aromatic plates of bacon-and-egg toast paired with hot Darjeeling tea rested squarely on the small wooden table by the window.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_27: Untying her apron to sit across from Sakaguchi, Artoria cut a bite of golden toast coated in warm yolk alongside crisp bacon and lifted it to her mouth.
nodes.ar4_s6_1_28: The very next second, every trace of gloom gathered in the kitchen vanished without a trace—those emerald-green eyes curving brightly once more:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_29: "...It's delicious! The egg whites are tender to perfection, and there isn't the slightest burnt bitterness to the bacon... Sakaguchi-kun, did you turn the burner down to the lowest setting the moment the whites began to set?"
nodes.ar4_s6_1_30: Chuckling, Sakaguchi nudged the strawberry jam jar toward her hand:
nodes.ar4_s6_1_31: "Right—a skillet conducts heat fast, so you can't stubbornly hold medium heat the way the book says. Low flame and residual heat do the trick."
nodes.ar4_s6_1_32: Artoria nodded in complete earnest, committing that heat-control tip to memory as diligently as a vital clinical note.
nodes.ar4_s6_2_01: Warm morning sunlight spilled across the pale wooden tabletop.
nodes.ar4_s6_2_02: Both generous breakfast plates were soon polished clean. Cradling her warm teacup in both hands for a sip, Artoria let out a quiet, contented breath, radiating an unguarded softness almost never seen inside the hospital.
nodes.ar4_s6_2_03: After a brief hush, she looked down at the clear reflection rippling in her black tea, seeming to recall Sakaguchi's words by the stove—'not so you'll pay it back with something else'—and began speaking gently:
nodes.ar4_s6_2_04: "...What you said just now, Sakaguchi-kun, reminded me a little of something at the hospital I haven't quite sorted through lately."
nodes.ar4_s6_2_05: Setting down his knife and fork, Sakaguchi looked at her quietly:
nodes.ar4_s6_2_07: Artoria gave a slight nod. Here there were no subordinates before whom she had to uphold authority at every instant—only an equal peer and lover who understood every word she meant, leaving no need to hide her hesitation:
nodes.ar4_s6_2_08: "After we finished Irisviel's operation, I said that a leader is also someone who serves the team. When it is a situation like that day—where Moe wasn't ready to scrub solo on instruments for a major case, so I had her observe and assist by safety standards—that kind of decision isn't hard to make, because it is genuinely best for both her and the patient."
nodes.ar4_s6_2_09: Her fingertips brushed lightly along the warm porcelain rim, an honest, unvarnished gravity surfacing in her emerald eyes:
nodes.ar4_s6_2_10: "Yet these past few days I keep wondering... what if one day two young clinicians standing before me are both thoroughly prepared and have both given everything they have, while I hold only one position or opportunity to give? Or what if two legitimate needs collide head-on, and whichever way I choose, I am bound to disappoint someone I genuinely care about?"
nodes.ar4_s6_2_11: Lifting her eyes to Sakaguchi without a trace of shirking weakness, she calmly laid bare the incision she found hardest to make:
nodes.ar4_s6_2_12: "Until now, so long as I covered an extra shift on the roster myself, skipped a meal, or stayed two hours later, most friction could be quietly smoothed over on my own back. Deep down I know perfectly well that not every conflict can be solved by carrying a little more myself... yet the clearer I see how much heart each person poured in, the heavier it feels when I have to hand that disappointment over with my own hands."
nodes.ar4_c3a_01: Meeting her earnest gaze, Sakaguchi spoke calmly and candidly:
nodes.ar4_c3a_02: "Artoria, looking out for the whole team has never meant having a magic way to leave every single person smiling. Even the right trade-off will still leave someone disappointed—that doesn't mean you chose wrong. And don't forget: you're a member of that team too. You can't keep throwing your own time and body underneath every dilemma first."
nodes.ar4_c3a_03: Listening quietly, Artoria let her lashes stir as she murmured:
nodes.ar4_c3a_04: "...Not throwing myself underneath every time, hm."
nodes.ar4_c3b_02: "If the day ever came when you could brush off someone's disappointment like an irrelevant number without blinking, you probably wouldn't be the Artoria everyone trusts anymore. Feeling that weight isn't a weakness—just stop trying out of habit to patch every gap by skipping meals and working late, or sooner or later you'll turn yourself into the most exhausted link of all."
nodes.ar4_c3b_03: Artoria blinked once, that taut thread in the depths of her eyes gradually softening:
nodes.ar4_c3b_04: "...When you put it like that, Sakaguchi-kun, my chest feels a little lighter."
nodes.ar4_c3c_01: Sakaguchi offered an open, easy smile:
nodes.ar4_c3c_02: "Truth be told, how to handle the aftermath when two promising people vie for a single spot is a question I'm still working through myself. Though one thing is different from before—next time a problem comes up that two extra hours of overtime won't fix, at least you won't have to sit over cold tea wrestling with it alone."
nodes.ar4_c3c_03: Taking in his steady, forthright gaze, Artoria let genuine warmth curve her lips:
nodes.ar4_c3c_04: "...Yes. Simply being able to say these half-formed thoughts straight to you already makes them feel much lighter."
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_01: Sakaguchi topped off her cup with the last warm splash of Darjeeling tea, drawing the conversation gently back:
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_02: "Besides, accepting backup from a colleague at the hospital is for the sake of a good operation; here in your own home, eating a breakfast I cooked for you doesn't even need an excuse like 'improving afternoon work efficiency.'"
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_03: Looking across at the golden-haired woman, he added the second half with a smile:
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_04: "Purely because I care about you and wanted to cook it for you—that reason alone is plenty."
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_05: Sunlight streamed through the windowpane, falling quietly across the soft rosy warmth on Artoria Pendragon's cheeks.
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_06: She looked down at the spotless empty breakfast plate before her, then raised her gaze back to the man sitting across the table.
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_07: Those questions of team trade-offs and the race for chief of surgery had not vanished overnight—tomorrow, when she put her white coat back on and walked into Hoshimi Hospital, she would still be the deputy chief who yielded not an inch and gave her all, standing squarely and honorably on the field of competition;
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_08: Yet in this moment's morning light, she finally set down the self who worried endlessly over everyone else, breaking into an unclouded, contented, radiant smile:
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_09: "...Yes. For this morning at least, I want to set everything else aside and savor the breakfast you made, Sakaguchi-kun."
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_10: Rising to gather both of their plates, she paused beside Sakaguchi and tilted her face slightly upward toward him, her emerald-green eyes brimming with tender warmth and a spark of spirited resolve:
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_11: "Still, the next time you stay the night here—let's make breakfast together the following morning. I'll entrust the primary surgeon's role at the stove to you first, Sakaguchi-kun, and handle the prep work and black tea myself."
nodes.ar4_s6_2m_12: Taking her free hand in his, Sakaguchi nodded with a smile:
